Chest.name: Loaded Pec Bottom Hold
Chest.desc: Use a deliberately lighter load and hold a deep, comfortable pec position while keeping the shoulders packed. Stay muscularly active instead of relaxing into the joint.

Back.name: Loaded Lat Lengthened Hold
Back.desc: Use a light load or assistance and reach into a long lat position while keeping active shoulder control. Avoid a painful passive hang.

Shoulders.name: Light Delt Lengthened Hold
Shoulders.desc: Use a very light load in a comfortable lengthened delt position while keeping the shoulder centered and controlled. Never force range.

Biceps.name: Loaded Biceps Lengthened Hold
Biceps.desc: Use a very light load with the arm slightly behind the torso and elbow comfortably extended. Keep the shoulder stable and the biceps under tension.

Triceps.name: Overhead Triceps Loaded Hold
Triceps.desc: Use a light overhead load, allow controlled elbow flexion, and hold the long head of the triceps in a comfortable stretched position.

Quads.name: Loaded Quad Bottom Hold
Quads.desc: Use a substantially reduced load and hold a deep pain-free knee-flexed position under control. Keep the knees tracking naturally.

Hamstrings / Glutes.name: Loaded Hinge Stretch
Hamstrings / Glutes.desc: Use a much lighter load, hinge with a stable spine until the hamstrings are strongly lengthened, and hold without chasing extra depth.

Calves.name: Loaded Calf Bottom Hold
Calves.desc: With a manageable load, lower the heel into a comfortable bottom position and hold under calf tension without bouncing or hanging on the Achilles.
